pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or scaling into losing positions; pyramiding is authorized only after the initial position has achieved +$10.00 floating profit and moved to break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry execution unless the order book imbalance exceeds 65% and multi-timeframe ATR expansion confirms directional momentum away from liquidity pools.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit capture when unrealized gains hit +$12.00, locking in minimum +$8.00 to force asymmetric $15-$30+ wins.
